### UTC Date & Time

[August 31, 2026, 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/aug-31-2026/2pm)

### Agenda

#### Discussions

* Updates on `glamsterdam-devnet-8`.
  * Led by @qu0b
* Plans for `glamsterdam-devnet-9`.
  * Led by @qu0b
* Let's have a mainnet shadow fork for testing snap/2.
  * https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2204#issuecomment-5478542706
  * Led by @nerolation
* Increase `MAX_SIGNED_INCLUSION_LIST_SIZE` to ~41 KiB.
  * https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2204#issuecomment-5453514921
  * Led by @jtraglia
* Align `engine_getInclusionList` checks with consensus-specs.
  * https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2204#issuecomment-5453514921
  * Led by @jtraglia
* Let's merge https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/793 so we can iterate.
  * https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2204#issuecomment-5478405534
  * Led by @RazorClient 

#### EL breakout

* Clarify behavior for undecodeable BALs.
  * https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2204#issuecomment-5449050068
  * Led by @nerolation
* Talk about EIP-8037 issues from partial review.
  * https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2204#issuecomment-5461653738
  * Led by @chfast 
* `eth/72` txsize is ambiguous for type-3 transactions.
  * https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2204#issuecomment-5479074806
  * Led by @qu0b 

#### CL breakout

* A new gossip check for bids to prevent missed proposals.
  * https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2204#issuecomment-5459533350
  * Led by @jtraglia
* Testing a payload with more than 8192 deposits.
  * https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2204#issuecomment-5479170688
  * Led by @jtraglia

comments.body: I'd like to briefly cover https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/869 , clarifying behavior for undecodable BALs.

- consensus-specs #[5576](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5576) — Derive MAX_SIGNED_INCLUSION_LIST_SIZE from transaction byte bound (41112 + non-empty rule)
- execution-apis #[870](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/870) — engine getInclusionListV1 bound = sum of tx byte lengths, no empty txs

I would like to discuss this extra gossip check for bids we should add:

* https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5580

EIP-8037 issues found after partial review:
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12249
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12256
- https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12265

I want to add discussion for the ssz engine api.
we would like to have all the clients finally review https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/793 and then merge it into the spec
and then work on the remaining features and also the changes.
merging this as the optional spec will allow us to k=move forward with the subsequent work and everything in that general direction
i'd like to talk about ideas around having a mainnet shadow fork for testing snap/2.
eth/72 `txsize` is ambiguous for type-3 transactions. Details: https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p/pull/281
If there's time, I would like to discuss how to test a payload with more than 8192 validator deposits on devnet-8.
